components.name: Global / Styles
components.note: V3 component with the two embeds. The custom embed holds the swash, hover and underline rules, the border model and the module state CSS. Replaces the 12 per-page style blocks and the duplicated site-footer copy.

components.name: Global / Nav
components.note: Today « Navbar ». Rename classes per the map; tag header.

components.name: Global / Footer
components.note: Today « Footer » with Image…Image 9 and Title…Title 4 props that never change. The column reads « Expertises » everywhere (decided), so the one override goes too. Tag footer.

components.name: Section / Page Header
components.where: Équipe, Expertises, Affiliations, À propos, Contenus, Contact
components.props: Title (slot), Subtitle (text), Description (rich text), Show description (visibility)
components.note: Title is a slot so each page keeps its h1 with the three highlighted words; a text prop can't carry the highlight spans. Verify slots in stage 1; fallback: Title as rich text if highlight spans survive, else keep the header as classes.

components.name: Section / Section Header
components.where: Accueil, Équipe, Expertises, profile and expertise templates
components.note: h2 with heading-style-h1. On templates the props bind to CMS fields (the related-content heading).

components.name: Card / Person
components.props: Image (image), Name (text), Title (text), Link (link); variant Size: md / sm
components.note: Figma Card (md, sm). Placed inside each Collection Item; props bound to the Équipier fields. Tone comes from CSS (list index), not a prop. The coverflow card is a different element (image only) and stays a class family.

components.name: Card / Post
components.where: Accueil, Équipe, Contenus, profile, expertise and content templates
components.note: Placed inside a list item, its author and tag lists would be nested lists inside a Component, which Webflow refuses. Stays one shared class family, Figma Blog Post (decided).

components.name: Tag list
components.note: Mostly nested inside post cards, so it can't be inside a Component there. Optional: a small UI / Tag Component for the item (Label, Link). Low value; not proposed.

components.name: Recent posts rows
components.where: Accueil, Équipe, profile and expertise templates
components.note: Lists whose cards hold nested lists, so they can't be inside a Component. Its heading is the Section Header Component; the rows stay classes. On templates they become the related-content rows plus the shared top-up pool (data-yx-related).

components.name: UI / Button
components.note: Figma Button. CA pattern (variant by role, never by colour). Optional: only 7 instances.
